public_health_question.v: Should video directly observed therapy be considered equivalent to in-person DOT for tuberculosis treatment in the United States?

ev.q: CDC reviewed published evidence on vDOT compared with in-person DOT for TB treatment adherence, completion, and microbiologic resolution
Recommendations for Use of Video Directly Observed Therapy During Tuberculosis Treatment
CDC recommends video DOT (vDOT) as equivalent to in-person DOT for persons undergoing treatment for diagnosed tuberculosis.
